hor po phyogs kyi gzhi bdag raka bkram gyi bsang mchod dge legs rgya mtsho bzhugs/kyai/sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ /don dam dbyings las shar ba na/

tei:div.tei:p: hor po phyogs kyi gzhi bdag raka bkram gyi bsang mchod dge legs rgya mtsho bzhugs/ kyai/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// don dam dbyings las shar ba na// srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa nyid// ma rtogs pa sems kyi rol rtsal las// rigs drug 'khor ba'i sems can gyi// 'gro ba mi dang lhan cig tu// phan gnod gnyis kyi stangs 'dzin cing*// sprul pa 'go ba'i lha lngar sprul// dgra bla yul lha mgon bu ni// sku lha raka bkram gnyan gyi rje// lha klu sman phran 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bzang shug phye mar dud pas bsang*// bdud rtsi rin chen phud kyi mchod// mthun pa'i g.yag lug ra gsum 'di// dar sna mda' dar gser g.yus brgyan/ spyan gzigs ma tshang med pa 'dis// gnas dang gzhi yi bdag po khyed// dgyes mnyes phul du phyin pa dang*// 'jig rten bde ba'i phrin las mjod// zhes pa'ang dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi ched du sngags btsun pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba'o//
